• Type: Natural gemstone / mineral specimen
  • Treatment: Unheated & untreated, unless otherwise noted
  • Certification: Accompanied by an independent laboratory report
  • Measurements: See exact carat weight and dimensions above
  • Care: Store away from direct sunlight, extreme heat, and household chemicals
We will work quickly to ship your order as soon as possible. Once your order has shipped, you will receive an email with further information. Delivery times vary depending on your location.

Founded on the belief that gemstones are Earth's most precious historical records, GeniGems seeks to bridge the gap between the mine and the connoisseur. Every stone in our gallery is hand-selected not just for its brilliance, but for its unique story.
